fieldValues.title: A response to a comment is a typed comment on it
fieldValues.decision_question: How does a writer's judgement on a comment (thumbs up or down, a task done or rejected) get recorded?
fieldValues.context: Owner, 2026-10-21, live in a Claude Code conversation. Remedies 0aa77274 (comment kinds; tasks ticked or rejected) and 7f697a33 (thumbs up or down) need the writer to judge a comment an agent created (srs-programme#189). Storing the judgement as fields on the agent's comment loses its provenance: the response is the writer's, not the agent's. The package already allows the alternative: com.semanticops.comments/comments-on is "Comment comments on any record", so a comment can target a comment.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
(a) Fields on the comment (task_state, verdict): simplest read, but the writer edits the agent's record and the judgement's provenance is lost. Rejected by the owner.
(b) Typed response comments (chosen): a judgement is the writer's own comment that comments-on the target comment, with a response kind.
(c) Do nothing: comments stay text only and both remedies cannot land.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Every judgement keeps its own author (createdBy) and time. The current state is readable without guessing.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A writer's judgement on a comment is a comment of its own that comments-on the target comment, with a response kind: agree or disagree (the thumbs), done or rejected (a task; the text is the reason). The current verdict or task state is the latest response by that author; changing one's mind is a new response, and history is kept.
fieldValues.rationale: A response is testimony of the person who gave it (RFC-046): it belongs in a record they created. The mechanism already exists (comments-on targets any record), so this adds kinds, not structure. How clients show responses (for example as badges, with conversation kept flat) is a UX convention, not part of this decision.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A second person writes on the same essay, or responses need kinds beyond these four.
